bullets.text: Heavy overnight rainfall caused widespread waterlogging and traffic disruption across Chennai, and the office should monitor clearance efforts.
An orange alert for heavy rain was issued for Chennai and Thiruvallur following the formation of cyclonic storms.
Firecracker incidents during Diwali destroyed vehicles and a house in areas including Adambakkam without injuries.
The Tamil Nadu government invited tenders to prepare a Detailed Project Report for restoring major waterways like the Cooum River and Buckingham Canal.
Power supply will be suspended in Rajakilpakkam and Velachery on Wednesday for maintenance works.
A young woman named Meghala was allegedly murdered by her illicit lover near Pennalurpettai in Thiruvallur district.
Burglars stole 30 sovereigns of gold jewelry from a house near Thiruvallur while the owners were away for Diwali.
Two men were arrested near Thiruvallur after a dispute over firecrackers resulted in a youth being slashed with a machete.
MeitY launched three indigenous AI models in New Delhi, marking a major milestone in India's artificial intelligence sovereignty.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launched the Semicon 2.0 portal and announced 12 new approvals under the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme.
American Vision Care Center announced the inauguration of its first AI-enabled vision care centre in Chennai.
Opposition leaders including Edappadi K. Palaniswami strongly condemned the government over multiple murders reported across Tamil Nadu during Diwali.
A major controversy has erupted over alleged irregularities and poor quality in a Rs 55 crore book procurement at Periyar Arivulagam.
